## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Ownership and compatibility

- [ ] Codex-owned Thread history, storage, models, cwd, and approvals remain untouched.
- [ ] Any CDP or undocumented Codex capability change fails closed.
- [ ] Resource ownership and cleanup behavior are documented for lifecycle changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] Real Codex Desktop evidence is included when Desktop integration changed.

## Assets and privacy

- [ ] New assets have documented redistribution rights.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and fixtures contain no credentials, private prompts, source code, or sensitive local paths.
